reviews.trigger_eval:
Descriptions compared: all 22 skills/*/SKILL.md (dotnet-upgrade, dotnet-diagnose, dotnet-release and the go/swift/jvm/nix/bazel/cmake/docs neighbours).
SHOULD-TRIGGER (all pick dotnet-upgrade only):
1. "Our library is on net8.0 and .NET 8 goes end of support next month. Add net10.0 and pin SDK 10 in global.json." Matches 'add net10.0, pin SDK 10 in global.json, EOS 2026-11-10'. dotnet-release (packaging) and dotnet-diagnose (explicitly 'Not for the net8 to net10 move') lose; go-upgrade and swift-upgrade are other languages.
2. "I bumped global.json to 10.0.401 and now the build fails with error IDE0370 and CA2025; what order should I do this in?" IDE0370 and 'an SDK ... change shows' are in dotnet-upgrade; dotnet-diagnose lists neither code and defers the net8 to net10 move to dotnet-upgrade. Only it fires.
3. "The net10 upgrade branch is a mess, how do I roll it back, then migrate our .sln to .slnx?" Matches 'migrate a .sln to .slnx or undo a failed upgrade'. Only dotnet-upgrade.
SHOULD-NOT-TRIGGER neighbour: "dotnet test exits with code 5 and says Zero tests ran on my xunit.v3 project." Belongs to dotnet-diagnose (names 'Zero tests ran', exit code 5, Microsoft.Testing.Platform); dotnet-upgrade's description does not name that symptom, so it correctly stays quiet. (A second neighbour, "cut v1.2.0 of the NuGet package and push the tag", picks dotnet-release.)
Weak spots recorded as UPG-23: the post-upgrade message 'Testing with VSTest target is no longer supported' and `test.runner` are not in the description, so that exact symptom could route to dotnet-diagnose; NETSDK1045 appears in both dotnet skills, and only the 'after an SDK or TFM change' wording separates them. The date-shaped trigger 'when .NET 8 and 9 reach end of support' is not something a user types and goes stale after 2026-11-10.

reviews.report:
PHASE 8 REVIEW: rules/csharp-quality/testing.md (branch csharp, 286 lines, 33 rows CS-TEST-01..31 + CS-CI-01..07). Read-only. Fixtures: /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/dotnet-tools/fixtures/review-testing/ (mk-green.sh, mk-red.sh, run-cells.sh, cells/ extracted verbatim from the unit's two sh blocks, miss/ tree, pk/ restored packages, civ/ 19 workflow mutations, ca1515/ posture build). SDK 10.0.401 via run.sh, absolute ripgrep (the shell hook rewrites plain rg), GNU awk 5.3.2, bash and dash.

VERDICT: the rows are faithful and the static cells mostly work, but 4 major problems (CA1515 build breaker, a CRLF guard that is silent under sh, a 86 percent false-positive cs-test-15, and a CI checker/cell that cannot see the clauses CS-CI-01/03 rely on) and 17 minors. Nothing blocks the unit once F01-F05 are applied.

1. VERIFICATION HONESTY
Method: the 34 runnable cells (4 cs-ci + 27 cs-test-01..27 + 29 + 31 + the cs-test-22 guard) were extracted verbatim and run in a GREEN tree (everything conformant, committed in git) and a RED tree (one plant per cell, 40 plants), plus a MISS tree (violations the row forbids but the cell may not see) and FP twins. cs-test-16/17 (dotnet list package) ran on two restored projects: FluentAssertions 8.0.1 + Moq 4.20.1 printed both hits, 7.0.0 + Moq 4.20.2 printed nothing. check-ci-matrix.sh ran on the green workflow (OK all rules, rc 0) and 19 single-mutation variants: R2-R13 each went red; actionlint 1.7.12 went red without .github/actionlint.yaml (ubuntu-26.04 unknown) and green with it; test-greps.sh OK on green, FAIL lines on red. CS-TEST-06 property measured: filter matching nothing exits 8 without the line, 9 with it, 0 on a normal run; --logger trx exits 5.
GREEN: every violation-printing cell is empty, every presence cell shows its hit; no cell goes red on the green twin. No placeholder, no error exit. RED: every cell goes red on its plant, except the count-by-eye cells (06, 07, 29) which only print lines a human must count (F10) and cs-test-29 which stayed at count 2 after a property was deleted.
MISSES (rule forbids, cell silent): element-form ReferenceOutputAssembly (03, F08), `{ return; }` and RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform returns (04, F09), `<NoWarn Condition=...>`, a second test .editorconfig section (12, F06), `.Result` (13, F07), CRLF under sh (24, F02), ci-ok with runs-on before needs (ci-03, F04), removed PR leg / non-fail-fast second matrix / missing timeout-minutes / older Alpine SDK / needs [test, nightly] (ci-07, F05).
FALSE POSITIVES on real trees (sampled by reading, hits per cell up to 10): cs-test-15 on NLog 3 hits (1 true), opentelemetry-dotnet 10 (0), grpc-dotnet 6 (0), RestSharp 10 (3 true NtlmTests), kiota 0: 4 of 29 true, 86 percent false (guard clauses in helpers, while-loops, event handlers). cs-test-13 `.Wait()` hit ManualResetEventSlim in 6 of 8 sampled otel hits; ConfigureAwait/None/Wait hits elsewhere true. cs-test-14 on otel: 2 of 6 files true, the rest a helper (EnvironmentVariableScope) and test apps. cs-test-24 CallerFilePath hit NLog's own LogEventInfo.CallerFilePath and otel attribute helpers (the latter true). cs-test-03 hit a comment path in NLog (false) and a real `FileName = "dotnet"` (true). cs-test-26 hits are mostly legitimate POSIX literals outside property tests (scope). cs-test-11, 20, 21, 25, 27, 29 true or silent on all 5 trees; cs-test-09/10/12/16 true (opentelemetry-dotnet really runs xunit and MSTest; its test projects really carry `<NoWarn>CA1515`, supporting F01). cs-ci-07 actionlint fails real workflows on a new permission scope (kiota, actionlint 1.7.12) and on shellcheck info lines (RestSharp, kiota) (F20).

2. FIDELITY
Row meaning and severity match the consolidations for all 38 rows (MUST/SHOULD identical; 24, 25, 08, 17, 31, CI-06 SHOULD). IDs 01-31 and CI-01..07 all present, none retired in this file (retirements live in processes.md). Authoring notes applied: T1 four tiers + .Baseline twin, T2 Linux+Windows coverage, T3 R12, C5 seven IDs, C6 doc file inherited, N-12 shapes. Drops: CS-TEST-24 loses "refuses update mode when CI is set"; the failure-mode list loses consolidation row 7 (F16). CS-TEST-28 cites the wrong IDs for the table-diff gate (F12).

3. CONTRADICTION
tests/FakeCliTests (errors.md CS-ERR-12/14/15) against tests/Ocx.Sdk.FakeCliTests (testing.md, api-design.md) (F13, cross-unit). CS-TEST-03 "apphost only in executable-resolution tests" against CS-ERR-14, which drives the whole Behavior suite through a post-build apphost copy and cites CS-TEST-03 for it (F14). No conflict with CS-BUILD-12/14/17, CS-LANG-05, CS-OBS-02, CS-ASYNC-05/06, CS-SEC-06 (site pragma is allowed there, CS-TEST-12 "nowhere else" means severity relaxations), DN-RULE-02/07/09. performance.md G1 ignores CA1515, so the directive line does not trip it.

4. DELETION TEST
Candidate: the "xUnit1051 at error" clause and cs-test-13 first command. xUnit1051 is a warning promoted by TreatWarningsAsErrors; measured 4 errors with and without the globalconfig line (F18). CS-TEST-21..23 are MUST with no "wherever snapshots exist" scope although the pinned default bans snapshot libraries (CS-TEST-27/28), so a conformant tree goes red on cs-test-22 (F17). The rest passes: an agent adds IProcessRunner, mocks Process, early-returns, masks exit 8 and picks coverlet.collector unprompted.

5. ERA + PORTABILITY
Every version claim carries a version and (measured|read 2026-10-11); Windows rows say SDK 10.0.102; dated externals match N-11; unverified rows are labelled. No /home/ path, no run.sh, no fixture names, no 75. Leak: "the Python SDK" appears unlabelled in CS-TEST-20 and CS-TEST-30 rationales (F15). Ocx.* example names are labelled in the intro (accepted).

6. READING
House voice and imperative form hold; no hedging beyond the sanctioned "Default; the adopter may override" and the "about 20 lines" threshold. TOC present (file over 100 lines) and all nine anchors resolve. Label drift: cs-test-05 comment says "v2 leftovers" but runs the global.json jq; R13 is named "continue-on-error" in prose, R13 in the script header (F19). cs-ci-03 prints a hit on a pass although the block header says empty is the pass (F04).

DIRECTIVE (CA1515): measured on SDK 10.0.401, net8.0;net10.0, shipped analyzers.globalconfig + analyzers.editorconfig, Exe MTP test project with xunit.v3.mtp-v2 4.0.2. With the seven-ID section a `public static class Probe` and a `public sealed record Row` give 2 CA1515 errors per TFM (the public xunit test class itself is exempt); with `dotnet_diagnostic.CA1515.severity = none # CS-TEST-12` added to the same section the build exits 0 and `dotnet test` gives total 6, succeeded 6. The loop in cs-test-12 needs CA1515 added. See F01/F02 for the exact edits.

Adding dotnet_diagnostic.CA1515.severity = none to the section: build exit 0, test total 6 succeeded 6 (watched red/green 2026-10-11). Add to the ini block: 'dotnet_diagnostic.CA1515.severity = none     # public helper types in an executable test project; test classes are exempt'. Add CA1515 to item 2 of 'What Agents Get Wrong Here' (<NoWarn>CA1515).

findings.problem: The shipped section is the file CS-TEST-12 says carries its lines; it holds seven IDs and the header comment says 'exactly these seven IDs', so the directive is only half applied unless this file changes too (posture-check.sh step 5 then guards the new line).

findings.problem: The CRLF cell uses the bash-only $'\r' inside a block fenced sh; under dash/sh grep gets the pattern '$r' and the cell is silently green on a CRLF verified file.

findings.evidence: NLog 3 hits (1 true), opentelemetry-dotnet 10 (0), grpc-dotnet 6 (0), RestSharp 10 (3 true), kiota 0. Anchored fix: NLog 1, RestSharp 3, otel 0, grpc 0; red tree 2 (both plants); green 0; miss tree 1.

reviews.report:
PHASE 8 ADVERSARIAL REVIEW: rules/csharp-quality/processes.md + binaries.md (worktree csharp, date 2026-10-11). Nothing in the worktree was written. Fixtures: /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/dotnet-tools/fixtures/review-processes/ (green/, red/, green2/, canary/, canary2/, refl/, pins/, cells.sh, real-*.txt), all run through run.sh, SDK 10.0.401, net8.0 (8.0.31) and net10.0 (10.0.12). Real ripgrep 15.2.0 called by absolute path or inside scripts, because the Bash tool rewrites a top-level `rg` to grep.

OVERALL: no blocker. The ban set, the canary mechanism, the jq pin gate and the measured .NET claims hold. 7 major and 15 minor findings. The majors:
- Two MUST checks (CS-PROC-22 and P5) go red on code that CS-ERR-10 requires.
- The CS-PROC-13 grep is wrong both ways.
- CS-PROC-13/14 clash with CS-ASYNC-09's gate.
- CS-PROC-05 clashes with CS-ERR-06.
- The CS-BIN-10 ban leaves 10 net10.0 overloads open.
- The CS-BIN-21 refresh cell cannot run.
- The canary description, followed verbatim, fails its own Good twin.

1. VERIFICATION HONESTY (62 cells run, 11 failed)
Method: every backticked rg, jq, python3 and dotnet command in table Verification cells and fenced blocks was extracted programmatically into cells.json and cells.sh, so each runs verbatim. Cells 01-26 and 35-55 are the 47 grep cells (26 CS-PROC cells and 21 CS-BIN cells), and cells 27-34 are the 8 pipeline lines of blocks P1-P7 (P4 has two lines). Together that is the 55 grep and pipeline cells. They ran on:
- a GREEN fixture (an engine and bootstrap tree written to comply),
- a RED fixture (one planted violation per cell, one planted miss file),
- three held-out trees: dotnet__docker-tools, open-telemetry__opentelemetry-dotnet, Azure__bicep.

Also run:
- the jq pin gate on 8 pins files,
- the Analyzer Canary block as written, on both TFMs,
- RS0030 canaries for every PROC and BIN ban, with a NoBan twin,
- CA1416, CS0117 and CA1849-default probes,
- reflection counts of the ExtractToDirectory and HttpClient overload families,
- reflection probes of the measured claims (below).

Result per cell family:
- GREEN: all 55 grep and pipeline cells print nothing, or the one required line.
- RED: all 55 go red on a planted defect. Per-alternative `rg -o` runs show every alternative of the multi-`-e` cells fires.
- P1-P7 return xargs 123 on green. The doc says to read the output and not the status, and that is correct.
- P7 prints exactly the 4 mask names on green and 6 on a Modify/Write plant.
- Wiring: the NoBan twin raised 0 RS0030, so the claim holds. Without a globalconfig RS0030 is only a warning, and CA1849 is not raised at all (the "off by default in .NET 10" claim holds).
- Ban canary: the PROC set raised RS0030 on 24 of 24 planted lines on net10.0 and 23 of 23 on net8.0 (WaitForExit(TimeSpan) is net9+). The BIN set raised RS0030 on 17 of 17 lines, plus CA1416 on SetUnixFileMode, CA5359 and SYSLIB0014. The Good twins exit 0. CS-BIN-07: ToHexStringLower gives CS0117 on net8.0 and builds on net10.0.
- jq gate: exit 0 on the genuine file, exit 1 on trailing newline, 63 chars, 65 chars, empty pins, uppercase, non-hex and numeric version. The naive `^$` form exits 0 on the newline pin. Matches the text.

Measured claims re-measured, all confirmed:
- CS-PROC-03/CS-BIN-01: a bare name runs from the cwd before PATH on net8.0 and net10.0 (Linux), but only for the parent's cwd. psi.WorkingDirectory does not trigger it.
- CS-PROC-05: NativeErrorCode is dir 0, no x bit 13, text +x 8, missing 2, argv over 128 KiB 7.
- CS-PROC-16: the CTS(TimeSpan, TimeProvider) constructor throws at -2 ms and 50 d, accepts 49 d, and cancels at once at 0.
- CS-PROC-17: ProcessExit ran on SIGTERM on net8.0 and not on net10.0.
- CS-BIN-14: a stalled body read 8 bytes in 4056 ms under Timeout=1 s.
- CS-BIN-08: `$` matches a trailing \n and \A..\z does not.
- CS-BIN-07: ToHexString is uppercase.

Failed cells (11): CS-PROC-03 grep, CS-PROC-13 grep, CS-PROC-22 grep, P5, CS-BIN-13 grep, the CS-BIN-10 RS0030 gate, the CS-BIN-21 triangulate cell, the Analyzer Canary block as written, CS-PROC-19 cell 3 (src/Process), CS-BIN-12 (src/Bootstrap), CS-BIN-16 grep (FP).

Real-tree hit reading (up to 10 per cell, hit lines read):
- CS-PROC-03: `ConfigFileName = "OTEL_DIAGNOSTICS.json"`, `emptyFileName`, `HelpFileName` are false positives. BicepInstaller `FileName = "chmod"` and GitHelper `new ProcessStartInfo("git", ...)` are true positives.
- CS-PROC-13: every hit is false (SemaphoreSlim.WaitAsync(cancellationToken), `exportTrigger.WaitAsync(waitAndDelayCts.Token)`, a doc comment). docker-tools 7 of 7, OTel 6 of 6, bicep 4 of 4.
- CS-PROC-05: 115 hits in OTel and 103 in bicep (see finding 4).
- CS-PROC-12: DockerHelper `StandardInput.WriteLine(credentials.Password)` is a true positive.
- CS-PROC-15: CancelAfter and the unfiltered OCE catches are true positives. `.Token` (capital T) in tests is a false positive.
- CS-PROC-22: `Task.Delay(timeout, cancellationToken)` is a true positive.
- CS-BIN-07: `activity.ParentSpanId.ToHexString() == "000..."` is a false positive (ActivitySpanId, not Convert).
- CS-BIN-08: `^...$` consts flag as designed. They are not manifest validators, and the cell is a site-finder.
- CS-BIN-16: `WebRequestMethods` is a false positive. `ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback = this.ValidateServerCertificate` in OTel is a true positive.
- CS-BIN-17, CS-BIN-24 and CS-BIN-11 hits are true or test-only.
- CS-BIN-26 prints a TLS comment in OTel (benign, as designed).
- CS-BIN-14 hits `new HttpClient(handler)` in tests under src/.
- Misses planted and confirmed: CS-BIN-13 nested parens, CS-PROC-13 `WaitAsync(grace, ct)`, CS-BIN-08 `(?m)^..$` and `\A..$`.

2. FIDELITY
- IDs: PROC 01-22 and 25 present, 23 and 24 retired with a one-line marker. BIN 01, 02, 04-18, 20-22, 24-26 present, and 03, 19, 23, 27, 28 retired. Sibling files carry no live reference to a retired ID. Citations in skills/ and platform-and-paths.md name them as retired.
- Severities match the consolidations (PROC-05 and PROC-16 SHOULD, BIN-18 SHOULD, the rest MUST). No authoring note changed a severity.
- Authoring notes P1-P6, A1, B1, B3 and B4 are applied correctly. Examples: the PROC-03 resolver gains the pin and download tiers, the PROC-07 prefix gains the log-level flag, the PROC-15 timer uses the constructor form, and BIN-12 uses overwrite:false.
- Unfaithful or stale:
  - CS-PROC-03 drops the sentence "never steer the lookup through psi.Environment[PATH]" but keeps its grep (finding 9).
  - CS-PROC-19 still says "the raw report" (finding 14).
  - The failure-class lettering was compressed from A-I to A-G, merging the consolidation's "contract-shape" class into F and renaming its "gate false-green" class H to G (the "API-era" class is gone with PROC-23). Nothing cites the letters, so this is only noted.
  - The failure-mode list drops 10 of 25 rows. They are retired, covered by a rule, or moved to Pinned Decisions.
- CS-BIN-10: the shipped text says "one M: line per overload", but the ban file has 14 lines for a family that reflection counts as 24 on net10.0 (finding 5).

3. CONTRADICTIONS
Findings 1, 3, 4, 13, 14, 15, 16 and 24. Finding 1 is a pair of cells red on a compliant tree. Findings 3-4 and 13-16 are rule-versus-rule clashes.

4. DELETION TEST
Finding 19 (CS-BIN-01, CS-BIN-05, CS-BIN-16 clause, CS-PROC-16). The rest of the unit is wrong-by-default material (string argv, sequential reads, bare Kill, encodings, cwd hijack, trust check, exit-number tables, retry on 75, ToHexString ==).

5. ERA AND PORTABILITY
- No /home/ paths, .cache, run.sh or consolidation names.
- Version claims carry measurement dates. runtime#114847 has no version or date (finding 20).
- `ocx` names are labelled as examples, but two grep-bearing names are missing from the rename list (finding 12), `exit_code`/`kind`/`status`/`contract` are not labelled as the tool's contract shape, and "the Python SDK" is undefined (finding 21).
- 75 and temp_fail are labelled examples, as accepted.

6. READING
- TOCs are present on both files and every anchor resolves.
- No hedging.
- Voice: some rule cells open declaratively and run past one sentence (finding 23).
- The checks path is written differently from every sibling (finding 22).

findings.evidence: Declarative openers: CS-PROC-15, 17, 18, 19, 21 and CS-BIN-22, 25. rule-distillation.md Rule Anatomy: "One imperative sentence. Says what to do, not what to consider."

reviews.trigger_eval: Routing is sound, with one gap. Both depth files carry the never-matching glob, and csharp-quality.md lines 141-142 route by task as the distillation guide wants: "Launching or stopping the wrapped tool..." to processes.md, and "Locating, selecting, downloading, hash-pinning, verifying, installing or caching a native binary the library launches" to binaries.md. Four rules in binaries.md apply to any download code, not only a native binary the library launches: CS-BIN-10 (never use whole-archive extractors), CS-BIN-11 (cap while streaming), CS-BIN-14 (one HttpClient) and CS-BIN-15/16 (redirects, TLS). A task like "extract this tar.gz" or "add an HttpClient download with redirects" has no routing row, so the agent edits without them. Add those subjects to the binaries.md routing row. The processes.md summary front matter is one long sentence (about 60 words) but triggers well. Both files carry a TOC, and every anchor resolves.

reviews.report:
REVIEW RECORD, phase 8, unit rules/dotnet-build.md + dotnet-build/packaging.md + dotnet-build/checks/*. Date 2026-10-11. Worktree untouched. Fixtures: /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/dotnet-tools/fixtures/review-build/ (mk.sh builds work/green with src/Lib and work/pkg with src/Pkg.Lib, both following every row and using the shipped checks/ files verbatim; cells/ holds each cell extracted verbatim from the md; rc.sh, mut.sh, repack.sh, held.sh, gate-run.sh drive them). SDK 10.0.401 via run.sh, net8.0;net10.0.

VERDICT: the unit is sound in structure and mostly honest, but 4 majors block "every runnable cell was watched red and green": the tl-flags cell fails the unit's own gate block, the CS-PKG-06 presence cell fails the shipped posture layout, the CS-BUILD-24 cell flags the placement the row allows, and the .slnx "writes no nupkg" measurement does not reproduce. Plus one cross-sibling contradiction (CS-PKG-09 vs CS-API-12).

1. VERIFICATION HONESTY (64 cells run: 17 named blocks in dotnet-build.md, 28 inline CS-BUILD cells, 12 named packaging blocks, 5 inline CS-PKG cells, the gate block, posture-check.sh)
Green baseline: the full gate block exits 0 on work/green (restore, build, format, test, pack, both nuspec budget tests) once global.json also carries test.runner (without it the gate stops at `dotnet test` with MSB1001; see f-gate-runner). posture-check.sh exits 0 on the shipped set and exits 1 with the right message on duplicated fragment, deleted ID line, lowered RS0030, unregistered ban file, duplicated ID line, lowered IDE0055, missing ban files, edited collection-expression option, and a second RS0030 in a nested .editorconfig.
Cells that went red on a planted defect and stayed silent on green (clean): b01 (csproj TFM), b02 (netstandard2.1/net9.0/net6.0/net462/netstandard1.x/net461/net7.0-windows), b04 grep and langversion block (latest, latestMajor, preview, unset), b05 (#if NET8_0, !NET8_0, (NET6_0||..); silent on NET8_0_OR_GREATER and NETSTANDARD2_0), b10 grep and analysislevel block (latest-all, 10.0-allx, 10.0.401-all, unset, AnalysisMode beside it; silent on AnalysisModeSecurity), b11, b12 (NoWarn with IDs, pragma without reason, awk reason line, count 5 -> 6), b14, b15 packs/MeziantouAnalysisMode/StyleCop-Roslynator-NetAnalyzers, b16, globalconfig-one (two files, misplaced file, missing file), canary (0 on ConfigureAwait fix, RunAnalyzers=false, typo level), global-json and sdk-assert on 12 invalid forms (trailing comma, 10.0, 10.0.x, latestFeatur, SDK key, "false" string all non-zero), audit-assert (exit 1 with -p:NuGetAudit=false, exit 0 without), b25, b26, b27 greps, b28, b29, nuspec-meta (bare tree exit 1, 6 of 6 exit 0), config-bans (SourceLink, license/icon URL, DeterministicTimestamp, pdb trick, SignAssembly, snk), p04, cib-probe (unconditional, CI-keyed, removed), repro (EQUAL on two clones, no output when Deterministic=false or epoch removed), tag-version (shallow clone exit 1, tag checkout exit 0), p09, validate-loop (non-deterministic pack exit 1), no-binary (runtimes/*/native, ocx.exe, 6 MB blob), workflow-pins (SHA-1 style pins, tag pins, email user, id-token on verify, missing environment), push-gate (no --skip-duplicate, branches, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, second dotnet pack), signing-gate, ns20-leg (red and green), ns20-pack red (3 Polyfill dependency lines) and green (PrivateAssets=all, silent).
Cells with defects, each with its fixture:
- tl-flags (CS-BUILD-30): green twin goes red. The awk demands `--interactive false --disable-build-servers` on every flagged verb including pack and clean, but DN-RULE-10 limits --disable-build-servers to build, publish, restore and the unit's own gate pack line carries only `--tl:off --interactive false`. g-gate-tl (gate copied to eng/gate.sh) prints the gate's pack line; work/green release.yml pack line is flagged; flag order matters (`--disable-build-servers --tl:off --interactive false` flagged); a line-wrapped build is flagged; `dotnet build-server shutdown` (the DN-RULE-10 first response) is flagged; `dotnet nuget push --interactive false` and `dotnet package list --interactive false` are not caught (second grep only covers `dotnet test`).
- p06 (CS-PKG-06 presence check): green twin goes red. `grep -q ... Directory.Packages.props` exits 1 on work/pkg, where MinVer sits in the shipped Directory.Packages.analyzers.props imported by Directory.Packages.props (the primary install route in CS-BUILD-15 and the props header). CS-SEC-10 also says Directory.Packages.props, so the three texts disagree on where the block lives.
- b24 (CS-BUILD-24): `grep -rn --include='Directory.Build.props' ... CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled .` recurses, so tests/Directory.Build.props, the placement the row blesses, is flagged (g-b24). A packable csproj body (r-b24b) and any .targets are not scanned; only the later nuspec command covers it.
- tfm-removal (CS-BUILD-08): `git diff ... | grep -E '^-.*TargetFrameworks'` fires on any edit of the line, including adding net12.0, so "prints a line only in a change that is also a major release" is not what it does (work/tr). It also dies with `fatal: bad revision 'origin/main'` without that ref.
- ns20-pack (CS-BUILD-06): `pack ... && unzip ... | grep` is silent when the pack fails or the project path does not exist; on work/green it prints nothing, exit 1, and pack.log says MSB1009 (src/Pack/Pack.csproj is a third example path). It also breaks on a stale artifacts folder holding two nupkgs.
- cold-restore (CS-BUILD-27): cannot go red for the named defects. With the mapping removed (r-b27c) or `<clear />` removed (r-b27a) the restore still exits 0; only the two greps catch them. It does go red for an unreachable source or a mapping that excludes needed packages (r-pc).
- b13g, b22, tl-flags, ns20-leg, push-gate, workflow-pins, b27a/b27b: operands `eng`, `.github`, `tests`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `nuget.config` are hard-coded. A missing operand prints `grep: eng: No such file or directory` (exit 2), so "empty output = pass" is false on 5 of 5 held-out trees (no `eng` anywhere), and `NuGet.config` (opentelemetry-dotnet, docker-tools) makes b27a/b27b error although the index itself globs three spellings. ns20-leg prints FAIL plus noise on RestSharp, whose test dir is `test`.
- Narrow file scope (misses, planted): b01 ignores a TargetFrameworks set in tests/Directory.Build.targets (r-b01b); b04/b10/b23/b28 skip .targets or other props; b23a does not see a multi-line PackageReference with Version on the next line (r-b23b) or Version in tests/Common.props; b12b misses a bare `#pragma warning disable`; b12 does not scan severity none in .editorconfig (r-b12e); b13g and b22 skip a root build.sh; b16, setup-dotnet and format-needs-build use --include='*.yml' so a .yaml workflow is invisible (r-b16d, r-b21b) while p09b and b13g do scan yaml; push-gate misses a `nuget push` without `dotnet` and a `--skip-duplicate` on a continuation line is a false positive; b05 drops the consolidation's NETCOREAPP alternative (irrelevant under the allow-list).
- Outer-evaluation-only reads: langversion, analysislevel, audit-mode, twae read the project without a TargetFramework, so a per-TFM Condition override (r-b04d LangVersion 12 on net8.0, r-b26d NuGetAuditMode direct on net8.0) stays green. The consolidation's CS-BUILD-26 loop per TFM was dropped.
- Count cells: b14b, b14c, b27b use `grep -c` (lines): three properties on one line give 1, a duplicated line plus a missing one gives 3 (r-b14b3, r-b14c4), two `pattern="*"` on one line print 1 (r-b27b), `<clear/>` or `pattern='*'` print 0 on a valid file (r-b27f). packs prints 6 for MinVer demoted to a plain PackageReference (r-b15d).
- version-source: misses elements with attributes (`<Version Condition=...>`, `<AssemblyVersion Condition=...>`: r-ver6, and 5 hits on the held-out devlooped__moq), and no cell checks MinVerTagPrefix (r-ver5).
- readme-images: `[^h]` lets any relative path starting with h pass (hero.png, header.png, how-it-works.svg: r-img2); fenced code images are false positives.
- workflow-pins: the key grep needs NUGET...KEY, and the second pattern needs an unquoted `-k|--api-key ${{`; `--api-key "${{ secrets.NUGET_TOKEN }}"` and `secrets.PUBLISH_KEY` pass (r-wp-secret3/4). A workflow-level `id-token: write` prints a blank line, not an exit code.
- b22 (`grep -w dnx`) flags `dnx-foo`, `# dnx is banned` and `npx dnx`; b12a flags any 3-digit NoWarn (intended); b28 flags a comment that mentions NU1510; p09b flags a comment; ns20-leg flags a comment mentioning netstandard2.0 (r-ns20d) and passes any `net472` substring in a README-like props comment (r-ns20c).
- tag-version: the exit code is the `test`'s; removing fetch-depth leaves exit 0 with an empty grep (r-fd), so only a human reading catches it.
Held-out trees (RestSharp, opentelemetry-dotnet, grpc-dotnet, kiota-dotnet, plus moq for one probe), hits read at up to 5 per cell: b01/b02/b04/b12/b14/b15c/b23a/b25/version-source/p09b/workflow-pins hits are true positives of the rule as written. Noted false positives: b02 on netstandard2.1 in a comment and in Condition lines (grpc Directory.Build.targets, kiota), b01 flags `<TargetFrameworks>$(TargetFrameworksForTests)</TargetFrameworks>` (central variable reuse, a policy call), b12b bare `disable 618` numeric pragmas are true positives. The Gate was not run on held-out trees.

2. FIDELITY. All rows present: CS-BUILD-01..06, 08, 10..18, 20..30; CS-PKG-01..15. CS-BUILD-07 marked retired, 09 and 19 marked never assigned. Severities equal the consolidations (17, 18, 08 SHOULD; 28, 29, 30 SHOULD; PKG-05, 13, 14 SHOULD). Amendments follow the notes: C1/C2 (CA1062 out, CA1867 in, count 5 verified), C3/N-6 (five packs plus MinVer, versions equal the props file), C5 (one root .globalconfig), C6 (tests inherit GenerateDocumentationFile), C7 (flags only on five verbs), K1 (MinVer GlobalPackageReference), K3 (budget in CS-SEC-09). Non-negotiables equal N-3's twelve. Gate block is byte-identical to csharp-quality.md's. Unfaithful or unverified: (a) CS-BUILD-29 and the gate prose "dotnet pack on the .slnx exits 0 and writes no nupkg": not reproducible on SDK 10.0.401 in work/pkg, work/green and a copy of the author-index fixture, with and without -o, with --no-build after a Release build, and bare `dotnet pack` at the root (all write the nupkg and snupkg); (b) CS-BUILD-16 rationale: `dotnet format whitespace` and `style` do exit 0 on DateTime.Now, but the root `dotnet format --verify-no-changes --no-restore` that the row prescribes exits 2 with RS0030 (work/gt-now), so "never dotnet format alone" is argued from subcommand evidence; the build-first order is still fine; (c) the "watched red and green" blanket sentence is false for the cells in section 1.

3. CONTRADICTION. (i) CS-PKG-09 "leave PackageValidationBaselineVersion unset until the first stable release, then set to the latest stable" vs CS-API-12 "set to the last published version from the second release on (0.y.z included)". (ii) CS-BUILD-01 and non-negotiable 1 ("TFM list in the root Directory.Build.props and nowhere else", no csproj sets a TFM) vs CS-BUILD-03's required net472 test leg: only a TargetFrameworks line in tests/Directory.Build.props satisfies both cells (g-ns20), a csproj is flagged by b01 (g-ns20b). (iii) CS-PKG-06/CS-SEC-10 "in Directory.Packages.props" vs CS-BUILD-15's shipped Directory.Packages.analyzers.props. (iv) tl-flags vs DN-RULE-10. (v) CS-BUILD-24 cell vs the row's own allowed placement. No other sibling conflict found: CS-BUILD-14/CS-TEST-12, CS-BUILD-12/CS-LANG-05, CS-BUILD-30/DN-RULE-02, CS-PKG-06/K1 are consistent.

4. DELETION TEST. CS-BUILD-22 (dnx): the consolidation's own frequency row says "new in .NET 10; no corpus usage", and `dnx` appears nowhere in 5 held-out trees; an agent does not write it unprompted. CS-BUILD-08 (never remove a TFM in a patch): DN-RULE-06 already hands "any TFM lowering or removal" to the owner and the unit's cell cannot tell removal from addition. Everything else earns its row (measured traps). posture-check.sh does not assert ban lines present (deleting `Process.Start(String)` exits 0); weaken-check against BASE (CS-CORE-01) owns that, so not a finding.

5. ERA AND PORTABILITY. /home/ paths: none in the unit (grep over md, sh, txt, props, globalconfig, editorconfig). Leaks: analyzers.globalconfig line 104 "OCI references and digests are lowercase by spec" is an unlabelled reference-consumer reason in a shipped posture file that an adopter copies as its own CA1308 reason; packaging.md line 19 promises `example-org/pkg-demo` in the commands but it appears nowhere (stale), while `ocx` in no-binary is labelled and accepted. Example paths are inconsistent (src/Lib/Lib.csproj in the gate, src/Pack/Pack.csproj in ns20-pack, src/Pkg.Lib in packaging, Lib.slnx in audit-assert). Undated row-level claims (the index and packaging intro date the measurement run, so only a nit): CS-BUILD-22 dnx on SDK 10.0.3xx/4xx and 11, CS-BUILD-26 NuGet 9.0.200, CS-PKG-06 MinVer AssemblyVersion, CS-PKG-08 Microsoft quote, CS-PKG-13 NU3043. .NET 8/9 end 2026-11-10 and net462 2027-01-13 are dated.

6. READING. Imperative and unhedged throughout; both files over 100 lines carry a Contents line and every anchor resolves; the relative link dotnet-build/packaging.md resolves. Nits: packaging.md "Dates and Defaults" holds the cell-running conventions, not dates or defaults; CS-PKG-09 Verification ends "`NU1102`,." with a stray comma; "**The SDK** is a library that wraps a native tool, a pinned default" is hard to parse. Trigger side: the 16 globs cover every file the index names (.props covers Directory.Packages.analyzers.props, *.globalconfig covers analyzers.globalconfig); packaging.md never auto-loads by design; release.yml edits load neither file (workflow YAML is deliberately not globbed), so CS-PKG-11..13 only bind through the dotnet-release skill and the index routing row.

findings.problem: The tl-flags awk requires `--interactive false --disable-build-servers` (that order) on every restore, build, publish, pack and clean line, but CS-BUILD-30 and DN-RULE-10 only ask for --tl:off --interactive false, and --disable-build-servers only on build, publish and restore. The unit's own gate pack line fails its own cell.
findings.evidence: g-gate-tl: gate block copied to eng/gate.sh, `tl-flags` prints `eng/gate.sh:10: ... g pack dotnet pack ... --tl:off --interactive false`; work/green release.yml pack line flagged; r-b30c order `--disable-build-servers --tl:off --interactive false` flagged; g-b30 `dotnet build-server shutdown` flagged; r-b30d `dotnet clean --tl:off --interactive false` flagged; `dotnet nuget push --interactive false` and `dotnet package list --interactive false` pass because the second grep covers only `dotnet test`.
findings.fix: Rewrite the awk to test the two flags independently (`!(/--tl:off/ && /--interactive false/)`) for restore, build, publish, pack, clean, require --disable-build-servers only for build, publish, restore, match `dotnet (verb)( |$)` so `build-server` is skipped, and extend the second grep to `dotnet (test|msbuild|format|tool|package)` carrying --tl or --interactive.

findings.evidence: g-b24: tests/Directory.Build.props (imports parent, sets the property) prints the line, exit 0; r-b24b property in src/Lib/Lib.csproj and r-b24c in tests/Directory.Build.targets print nothing.

findings.problem: The row and the gate prose state that `dotnet pack` on the .slnx exits 0 and writes no nupkg (measured 2026-10-11, SDK 10.0.401). It does write the nupkg and snupkg in every layout tried, so the measured claim is false or its trigger condition is missing. Until then state only that the gate packs the project file to keep one nupkg per run; fix the sibling copies (observability.md nuspec block intro, security.md pack block and CS-SEC-09 cell, dotnet-diagnose catalogue captures).

findings.problem: CS-PKG-09 says leave PackageValidationBaselineVersion unset until the first stable release and then use the latest stable version; CS-API-12 says set it to the last published version from the second release on (0.y.z included). A 0.1.0 then 0.2.0 library gets opposite instructions, and CS-API-12 itself defers pack properties to CS-PKG.
findings.evidence: rules/csharp-quality/api-design.md CS-API-12 text vs packaging.md CS-PKG-09 text; the CS-PKG-09 cell only checks EnablePackageValidation and continue-on-error, so neither side is machine-checked.

findings.problem: The tfm-removal cell prints the old TargetFrameworks line on any edit of that line, including adding a TFM (which the row allows in a minor), and dies with `fatal: bad revision` when origin/main is absent.
findings.evidence: work/tr: after changing `net8.0;net10.0` to `net8.0;net10.0;net12.0` the cell prints `-    <TargetFrameworks>net8.0;net10.0</TargetFrameworks>`, exit 0.

findings.problem: The ns20-pack cell is `pack && unzip | grep`, so a failing pack or a wrong path produces empty output, which the table defines as the pass. Its project path src/Pack/Pack.csproj is a third example name that matches no other cell, and a stale artifacts folder with two nupkgs breaks the glob.
findings.evidence: work/green: the cell prints nothing and exits 1 while pack.log says `MSB1009: Project file does not exist. Switch: src/Pack/Pack.csproj`; the planted Polyfill-without-PrivateAssets tree (r-ns20pack) does print 3 dependency lines and the PrivateAssets twin prints none.
findings.fix: Use `rm -rf artifacts; dotnet pack src/Lib/Lib.csproj -c Release -o artifacts > pack.log 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: pack'; exit 1; }` then the unzip grep, with the same project path as the gate.

findings.problem: Cells hard-code operands that most repositories lack (`eng`, `tests`, `.github`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `nuget.config` in one spelling). A missing operand prints `grep: ...: No such file or directory`, so empty output is not the pass, and ns20-leg reports FAIL when the test directory is simply named `test`. The index globs three nuget.config spellings but the cells use one.
findings.evidence: All five held-out trees have no `eng`: b13g, b22, tl-flags print the grep error; opentelemetry-dotnet and docker-tools ship `NuGet.config`, so b27a/b27b print `grep: nuget.config: No such file`; RestSharp prints `grep: tests: No such file or directory` plus FAIL from ns20-leg; kiota/grpc/RestSharp have no .github/workflows/release.yml for push-gate and workflow-pins.
findings.fix: Add one sentence to the preamble (a missing directory operand prints `No such file`: drop it from the cell) or add `2>/dev/null`, replace `eng` with `$(git ls-files)`-free forms such as `--include` over `.`, and name the nuget.config glob (`find . -maxdepth 1 -iname nuget.config`).

findings.problem: cold-restore (exit 0 = pass) cannot go red for the defects the row names: a missing `<clear />` or a missing source mapping still restores with exit 0. Only the two grep counts catch them, and those count lines, so `<clear/>`, `pattern='*'` or two `*` patterns on one line give wrong counts.
findings.evidence: r-b27a (no <clear />) and r-b27c (no packageSourceMapping): `cold-restore` exit 0; r-b27b two patterns on one line prints 1; r-b27f valid XML with `<clear/>` and `pattern='*'` prints 0 and 0.
findings.fix: Label cold-restore as proving only the empty-cache restore, and replace the greps with `xmllint --xpath 'count(//packageSource/package[@pattern="*"])'` and `count(//clear)` (the consolidation had the xmllint form).

findings.problem: Several cells are narrower than their row: b16/format-needs-build/setup-dotnet include only *.yml so a .yaml workflow is invisible (b13g and p09b do scan yaml); b23a misses a multi-line PackageReference and Version in other props or targets; b12b misses a bare `#pragma warning disable`; b01, b04, b28 skip .targets or non-root props; b13g and b22 skip a root build script.
findings.evidence: r-b16d and r-b21b (workflow renamed ci.yaml: both cells silent); r-b23b (Version on the next line: silent); r-b12b bare `#pragma warning disable` not listed; r-b01b TargetFrameworks in tests/Directory.Build.targets silent; r-b13e `build.sh` at the root silent; r-b28b RestoreEnablePackagePruning in Directory.Build.targets silent.
findings.fix: Add `--include='*.yaml'` to the yml cells, use `grep -rn -z`/`xmllint` for PackageReference Version, add a `disable$` alternative to the pragma pattern, and add `*.targets` to b01, b04, b28.

findings.problem: langversion, analysislevel, audit-mode and twae read the effective value without a TargetFramework, so a per-TFM Condition override of the pinned value stays green; the consolidation looped per TFM for CS-BUILD-26.
findings.evidence: r-b04d (`LangVersion` 12 when TargetFramework is net8.0): langversion block prints nothing; r-b26d (`NuGetAuditMode` direct under a net8.0 Condition): audit-mode and b26g print nothing.
findings.fix: Add `-p:TargetFramework=net8.0` and `net10.0` passes (as the consolidation's CS-BUILD-26 loop did) or state that the blocks read the outer evaluation only.

findings.problem: version-source matches only attribute-free elements, so `<Version Condition=...>` and `<AssemblyVersion Condition=...>` pass; nothing checks MinVerTagPrefix.
findings.evidence: r-ver6 (`<AssemblyVersion Condition="...">1.0</AssemblyVersion>`) prints nothing; held-out devlooped__moq has 5 such hand-set versions (`<VersionPrefix Condition=...>`, `<Version Condition=...>`) the cell cannot see; r-ver5 (MinVerTagPrefix deleted) is silent and CS-PKG-07 only catches it at pack time.
findings.fix: Change the element pattern to `<(Version|...)[ >]`, and add `grep -q -e 'MinVerTagPrefix>v<' Directory.Build.props` as a presence line.

findings.problem: The readme-images pattern `[^h]` after `(` or `src="` lets every relative path that starts with h pass, and it flags images inside fenced code.
findings.evidence: r-img2: README with `![a](hero.png)`, `![b](how-it-works.svg)`, ``, `![c](help/x.png)` prints nothing, exit 1; g-img prints the `![code](a.png)` line from a fenced block.
findings.fix: Use `!\[[^]]*\]\((\./|\.\./|/|[^h]|h[^t]|http:)` and `src="(...)` with the same alternation, or invert it: list every image whose target does not start with `https://`.

findings.problem: workflow-pins catches only secrets named NUGET...KEY and an unquoted `-k|--api-key ${{ secrets`, so the usual quoted form with another secret name passes; a workflow-level id-token is visible only to a human reading the awk output.
findings.evidence: r-wp-secret3 (`--api-key "${{ secrets.NUGET_TOKEN }}"`) and r-wp-secret4 (`${{ secrets.PUBLISH_KEY }}`) print nothing from the two greps; r-wp-toplevel prints a blank line plus `publish:` twice.
findings.fix: Match `secrets\.` anywhere on a `nuget push` line (`nuget push.*secrets\.`) and any `secrets\..*(NUGET|API).*`, and make the awk exit non-zero unless exactly two `publish:` lines print.

findings.problem: CS-BUILD-03 requires a net472 test leg, but CS-BUILD-01 and non-negotiable 1 say no csproj sets a TFM and the list lives only in the root props. Only a TargetFrameworks line in tests/Directory.Build.props satisfies both cells, and the unit never says so.
findings.evidence: g-ns20 (net472 in tests/Directory.Build.props): ns20-leg and b01 silent; g-ns20b (net472 in tests/UnitTests.csproj): ns20-leg silent, b01 prints the csproj line.
findings.fix: State in CS-BUILD-03 that the net472 leg is set in tests/Directory.Build.props (the one allowed second place) and say so in non-negotiable 1.

findings.problem: The rationale argues the format step needs a build first from `dotnet format whitespace` and `style`, but the prescribed root command `dotnet format --verify-no-changes --no-restore` exits 2 on a tree containing DateTime.Now (its analyzers pass reports RS0030), so "never dotnet format alone" is not shown by the cited evidence.
findings.evidence: work/gt-now (SDK 10.0.401): root format exit 2 with `error RS0030`, `format analyzers` exit 2, `format whitespace` exit 0, `format style` exit 0.
findings.fix: Rewrite the rationale: the subcommands whitespace and style exit 0 on a banned API, the build names every analyzer error across both TFMs in one pass, so run the build first; drop or soften "never dotnet format alone".

findings.problem: The Gate's `dotnet test --minimum-expected-tests 1` line stops with MSB1001 unless global.json also carries `"test": {"runner": "Microsoft.Testing.Platform"}` (CS-TEST-09), but CS-BUILD-20's shape and its global-json cell omit it, so a global.json written to CS-BUILD-20 alone breaks the unit's own gate.
findings.evidence: First run of the gate on work/green with the CS-BUILD-20 shape: `MSBUILD : error MSB1001: Unknown switch.` and `gate: test exit 1`; adding the test section made it exit 0.
findings.fix: Add `test.runner` to the CS-BUILD-20 shape sentence (cite CS-TEST-09) and to the jq expression, or note it under the gate.

findings.problem: The reason line above CA1308 says OCI references and digests are lowercase, a reference-consumer fact in a file adopters copy as their own CA1308 justification; packaging.md also promises `example-org/pkg-demo` in its commands, which appears nowhere, and example project paths differ per cell (src/Lib/Lib.csproj, src/Pack/Pack.csproj, src/Pkg.Lib, Lib.slnx).
findings.evidence: analyzers.globalconfig line 104; packaging.md line 19 vs grep for example-org/pkg-demo (one hit, the intro); cells ns20-pack, audit-assert, gate, packaging cells.
findings.fix: Reword to a labelled example (`# Example reason, rename: the tool's identifiers are lowercase by spec`), delete `example-org/pkg-demo` from the intro, and use one reference project path in every cell.

findings.problem: CS-BUILD-22 (dnx) has no corpus support: the consolidation's frequency cell says no corpus usage and an agent does not write a .NET 10-only command unprompted; CS-BUILD-08 restates DN-RULE-06 (any TFM lowering or removal goes to the owner) and its cell cannot separate removal from addition.
findings.evidence: Consolidation failure-mode row 15 ("new in .NET 10; no corpus usage"); cell b22 has zero real hits in RestSharp, opentelemetry-dotnet, grpc-dotnet, kiota-dotnet, NLog; csharp-quality.md DN-RULE-06 text.
findings.fix: Fold CS-BUILD-22 into the dotnet-release/dotnet-diagnose skills or into DN-RULE-02 as one clause, and keep CS-BUILD-08 only as a pointer to DN-RULE-06.

findings.problem: Several row-level version claims carry no (measured|read 2026-10-11) tag, contrary to N-11: dnx behaviour on SDK 10.0.3xx/4xx and 11, the NuGet 9.0.200 audited-count requirement, MinVer's AssemblyVersion rule, the Microsoft strong-name quote, NU3043 on SDK 10. Also two reading nits: the "Dates and Defaults" heading holds cell-running conventions, and CS-PKG-09's Verification ends `NU1102`,.
findings.evidence: dotnet-build.md CS-BUILD-22, CS-BUILD-26 rationale; packaging.md CS-PKG-06, 08, 13, 09 text.
findings.fix: Append the date to each claim, rename the heading to "How to Run the Cells", delete the stray `,.`.

reviews.trigger_eval: dotnet-build.md: 16 globs cover every file the index names (.props covers Directory.Packages.analyzers.props, *.globalconfig covers analyzers.globalconfig, BannedSymbols*.txt, PublicAPI.*.txt, dotnet-tools.json, all three nuget.config spellings); .editorconfig and workflow YAML are deliberately not globbed (N-1), so editing release.yml loads neither dotnet-build nor csharp-quality and CS-PKG-11..13 bind only through the dotnet-release skill and the routing row. packaging.md carries the never-matching glob and is reached only via the index row; that row exists and links resolve. No trigger defect found.

reviews.report:
PHASE 8 REVIEW: rules/csharp-quality/api-design.md (CS-API-01..20) and errors.md (CS-ERR-01..17). Worktree read-only. Fixtures: /home/mherwig/.cache/research-lang/dotnet-tools/fixtures/review-api-errors/. Toolchain: .NET SDK 10.0.401 (also 8.0.425, 11 RC1), PublicApiAnalyzers 5.6.0, Meziantou MA0053, xUnit v3 on MTP. Run date 2026-10-11.

VERDICT: do not merge as-is. Pack/analyzer/compiler/serializer claims are correct. The regex scans and the table-diff guard are not. One cell goes red on green (F1), one guard has a hole (F3), and four scans have unusable false-positive rates (F5, F6, F7, F13).

1. VERIFICATION HONESTY
Method: extracted every verification cell verbatim (43 cells) into cells/NNN-*.sh; planted RED and GREEN twins (mkred.py / mkgreen.py); ran each rg/grep cell on 3 heldout trees (OTel, RestSharp, grpc-dotnet; kiota and NLog sampled for F7) with up to 10 hits per cell sampled; ran about 35 dotnet fixture variants for pack/analyzer/serializer/gate claims; about 25 edge probes.
Verified correct (claim reproduced, cell goes red on plant, green on twin): CP0002/5/6/9/14/17, PKV006, no-flag pack exit 0, RS0016/17/26/27/36/37, MA0053 with MeziantouAnalysisMode None, dotnet format analyzers exit 2 then 0 incl. undeclared-member behaviour, CS9035, CS1729, ACME0001 under pragma, SYSLIB1222 and SYSLIB1038 (silenced by NoWarn), probe seen=4 attrs=1, JsonRequired on get-only throws InvalidOperationException, CA1031 miss on filter and wrap forms, CA1032, CS8864, CS8652 for closed, CS9135, record ToString leaks password, MTP dotnet test --project exit 2 on drift, Assert.Equivalent strict, ERR Checks A and B, check-table-diff.sh red and green variants (except F3), 12a variants, 16b stale logic, A01-A20 greps in their simple forms.
Not verified as plantable: [Serializable] alone does not trip SYSLIB0051 (GetObjectData override does: CS0672 + SYSLIB0051); the claim leans on grep 07a for the bare attribute, which works.
Failures: F1 (red on green), F3 (guard hole), F4, F5, F6, F7, F8, F9 (three cells), F10, F11, F12 (two cells), F13. Also F14 (green prints one allowed hit; empty is not the pass).
Heldout false-positive tallies: API-04 get;set scan: OTel 33 of 76 hits and grpc 20 of 55 sit in files declaring no public type; RestSharp 7 of 140. Collection-in-record scan: OTel 79 hit lines, 62 in files with no record declaration, rest internal records, 0 true positives. API-06: grpc 3 of 3 false (CancellationToken), RestSharp 1 of 3. Closed-hierarchy block: RestSharp 5, OTel 15, NLog 21, grpc 18, kiota 2 hits, all extension-point abstract classes.

2. FIDELITY
IDs API-01..20 and ERR-01..17 all present, severities match the consolidation. No retired IDs in either file; errors.md says so. Authoring notes N-5 E1-E4 (NotSupportedException dropped from decode catch, PartialReport as object?, IsTransient marker, BatchRefused, CS-OBS-28 catch site in ERR-06), N-7..N-12 honoured. Cell-shape lints (no placeholder, no escaped pipe, xargs -r, pipes in fenced blocks) honoured. One uncovered deviation: F21. Unresolved cross-set conflict: F15 (PackageValidationBaselineVersion timing).

3. CONTRADICTIONS
F11 ERR-04 04a vs JSON-07 (compliant converter trips it). F7 API-08 block vs API-02 protected-ctor seam. F2 errors.md paths vs testing.md. F15 PKG-09 vs API-12/15/ERR-15. F16 ERR-01/04 vs JSON-20. F17 ERR-14 vs TEST-03. F18 five-leaf rule vs binaries.md download path.

4. DELETION TEST
Rows an agent gets right unaided: CS-ERR-11 (CONSIDER, no failure-list entry, single exemplar), CS-ERR-17 and CS-API-16 not in failure list, CS-API-06 overlaps CS-PROC-08 block P2. Recommend dropping ERR-11 or folding into ERR-08; demoting API-06 to a pointer at PROC-08. Analyzer restatements are fine: each names the gap the analyzer leaves (CA1031 filter forms, no gate sees required, MA0053 scope).

5. ERA AND PORTABILITY
No /home/ paths. ocx leaks: F19 (x-ocx-enum, message template, DestinationFiles ocx) unlabelled; 75 accepted as labelled sysexits example. Undated claims: F23.

6. READING
Both files carry Contents lines with resolving anchors, links resolve, house voice matches siblings (row length matches sibling practice). F20: "prints four values" is wrong, multiple -getProperty prints one JSON object.

trigger_eval note: frontmatter paths globs load on **/*.cs, Directory.Build.props, csproj; not re-measured beyond confirming the glob lists match sibling files. The cells that matter for triggering (A01-A20, ERR Checks) fire on plants but 6 of them fire on greens in heldout trees at rates that would train agents to ignore the output.

findings.problem: Checks C 15a runs dotnet msbuild src/Sdk -getProperty:PackageValidationBaselineVersion. src/Sdk does not exist, so msbuild errors MSB1009, yet the cell still prints its 15a marker on the GREEN tree. Cell goes red on green.
findings.evidence: Run on green fixture: MSB1009 project file does not exist, marker 15a printed, nonzero. Unit own example in CS-API-12 is src/Ocx.Sdk.
findings.fix: Use the set's path src/Ocx.Sdk (or a project glob via rg --files -g '*.csproj'), and make the marker print only when msbuild exits 0.

findings.problem: errors.md uses tests/FakeCliTests* and src/Sdk; testing.md CS-TEST-01 and api-design.md use tests/Ocx.Sdk.FakeCliTests and src/Ocx.Sdk. Checks C cells cannot run on the layout the rest of the set defines.
findings.evidence: Grep of both files against testing.md CS-TEST-01 and api-design.md CS-API-12; Checks C finds nothing on the green tree built to the set layout.
findings.fix: Replace tests/FakeCliTests* with tests/Ocx.Sdk.FakeCliTests and src/Sdk with src/Ocx.Sdk throughout errors.md.

findings.problem: check-table-diff.sh gates on $n.supersedes == null, so once a row already carries a supersedes block, later silent edits of expect or since pass with exit 0. The guard the rule relies on to forbid silent behaviour edits is bypassable.
findings.evidence: edge2 fixture: row with existing supersedes, expect changed with no new supersedes entry; script exit 0 (should be nonzero).
findings.fix: Compare head supersedes against base supersedes (jq deep equality). Flag an expect/since change unless supersedes was newly added or changed in the same diff.

findings.problem: CS-API-14 counts supersedes with git diff "$TAG"..HEAD -- '*behavior-table*.json' | grep -c '"supersedes"', which counts removed and context lines. A pure deletion of a stale supersedes block at a baseline bump gives count=1, read as a major signal. TAG=v1.0.0 is a hard-coded literal, not the last tag.
findings.evidence: Fixture with supersedes block removed: count=1.
findings.fix: grep -c '^+.*"supersedes"' and TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0).

findings.problem: CS-API-04 collection-in-record scan selects files containing the word record (prose, variables), then flags every collection token in the whole file. Same family: the public { get; set; } scan flags properties in internal types.
findings.evidence: OTel: 79 hit lines, 62 in files declaring no record, the rest on internal records, 0 true positives. RestSharp and grpc also hit outside public records. get;set scan: OTel 33 of 76 hits and grpc 20 of 55 in files with no public type (OtlpMtlsOptions.cs, OtlpTlsOptions.cs, SdkLimitOptions.cs).
findings.fix: Use rg -U to match a public record declaration parameter list or property lines only (public (sealed )?(partial )?record ...\([^)]*(List|Dictionary|IList)<) and restrict the get;set scan to files that declare a public type, ideally the PublicAPI.Shipped.txt members.

findings.problem: CS-API-06 scan matches Token inside CancellationToken and inside internal/private records. CS-PROC-08 P2 avoids this with \b(Token|Password|Secret)\b on the record parameter list.
findings.evidence: grpc 3 of 3 sampled hits false (CancellationToken); RestSharp 1 of 3 (RestClient.Async.cs).
findings.fix: Use \b(Token|Password|Secret|ApiKey)\b anchored to public record parameter lists, or drop the cell and point at PROC-08 P2 (see F22).

findings.problem: CS-API-08 closed-hierarchy block flags every public abstract class lacking an internal constructor. That contradicts CS-API-02, which prescribes public abstract class with a protected constructor as the extension seam. Rule scope is wire unions only.
findings.evidence: Hits: RestSharp 5, OTel 15, NLog 21, grpc 18, kiota 2; sampled all are extension points (BaseExporter, Sampler, Interceptor).
findings.fix: Scope the block to union roots (types with an Unknown case or [JsonConverter] naming them) and exempt abstract classes with a protected constructor.

findings.problem: CS-API-05 regex has no partial, missing public sealed partial record and public readonly partial record struct.
findings.evidence: Red fixture: public sealed partial record Zed(string A); and public readonly partial record struct Zq(...) both missed.
findings.fix: Allow (partial\s+)? in the modifier group before record.

findings.problem: Scans assume attribute and member on one line. CS-API-17 scan 5 derives names from [JsonConstructor] internal (\w+)\( on one line; with the attribute on its own line, names are empty and TakeMultiLine(Item item) is missed. CS-API-18 scans 1 and 3 use [^\n]* so [JsonInclude] and [JsonRequired] on their own line before the property are missed.
findings.evidence: Planted Y and W (own-line attribute) missed; same-line X, Z and Take(Report r) caught.
findings.fix: Use rg -U with \s* across newlines for the attribute-then-member shape in all three scans.

findings.problem: CS-API-14 comm cell flags an [Experimental] type as non-experimental when another attribute sits between [Experimental(...)] and the public declaration, and mis-extracts public sealed record class X (captures class).
findings.evidence: ReportV3 with [JsonConverter] between flagged; record class X yields name 'class'.
findings.fix: Allow intervening attribute lines (rg -U) and skip the record/class keyword when capturing the name.

findings.problem: ERR-04 04a greps JsonDocument\.Parse without the open paren. Compliant CS-JSON-07 TaggedUnionConverter calls JsonDocument.ParseValue, so 04a prints 'more than one decode file' on a tree that complies with both rules.
findings.evidence: edge4 fixture; JSON-09 G9 uses JsonDocument\.Parse\( and passes.
findings.fix: Use JsonDocument\.Parse\( in 04a.

findings.problem: ERR-06 cell catches only 'when (...) { return -1; }' and empty bodies. CA1031 does not flag filter forms, so analyzer-blind swallows slip through: filter plus log-then-return, filter plus log-only, when (!(ex is OCE)) with nested parens, comment-only bodies. ERR-05 cell misses wrapping catches with nested braces or a filter excluding the wrong type.
findings.evidence: edge3 variants: each missed by the cell and by CA1031.
findings.fix: Match the catch block with rg -U ('catch\s*\([^)]*\)\s*(when\s*\(.*\))?\s*\{[^}]*\}') then reject bodies containing throw; handle nested parens with a balanced-paren-free filter pattern.

findings.problem: ERR-09a matches non-public members; ERR-09b is noisy on plain forwarding Task methods; API-07 implicit operator ... (string and Enum.TryParse scans are repo-wide, not limited to open-enum or wire data; API-13 first cell hits commented // TODO: [Obsolete(...)] lines.
findings.evidence: 09a: NLog internal throwOnError, kiota private GetInnerExceptionAsync. 09b: RestSharp 12, kiota 11, grpc 42 lines. API-07: RestSharp ContentType, OTel env config parsing.
findings.fix: Anchor 09a to public; reduce 09b to methods whose body awaits and does not rethrow, or mark it advisory; restrict API-07 to files declaring record struct open enums; exclude lines starting with // in API-13.

findings.problem: Checks C 13a (.Message\b) and ERR-06 cell print one allowed hit on green (the canary reader line; the justified CA1031 site), so empty output is not the pass criterion and the file does not state the expected green output.
findings.evidence: Green fixture prints exactly one line each.
findings.fix: State the expected green output (exactly one hit, the named site) or exclude the sanctioned site with a marker comment the grep skips.

findings.problem: CS-PKG-09 says leave PackageValidationBaselineVersion unset until the first stable release. CS-API-12, CS-API-15 step 4 and CS-ERR-15 say set it from the second release on, 0.y.z included. Authoring notes do not resolve it.
findings.evidence: packaging.md CS-PKG-09 vs api-design.md CS-API-12/15 and errors.md CS-ERR-15.
findings.fix: Decide in packaging.md: align CS-PKG-09 to the 0.y.z-from-second-release rule (matches the research and the pack tests), then cite it from API-12.

findings.problem: ERR-01, the OcxDecodeException row and ERR-04 say undecodable stdout yields OcxDecodeException. CS-JSON-20 says an unaccepted non-zero exit with stdout problems still yields OcxCommandException. errors.md neither cites JSON-20 nor carves it out.
findings.evidence: errors.md ERR-01/04 vs json.md CS-JSON-20.
findings.fix: Add a clause to ERR-04: on an unaccepted non-zero exit the command exception wins (see CS-JSON-20); decode exception applies on accepted exits.

findings.problem: ERR-14 launches the apphost in the Behavior harness; CS-TEST-03 allows the apphost only in executable-resolution tests. The consolidation framed ERR-14 as that case; the unit dropped the cite.
findings.evidence: errors.md ERR-14 vs testing.md CS-TEST-03.
findings.fix: Reword ERR-14 as the executable-resolution test and cite CS-TEST-03.

findings.problem: errors.md 'no sixth acquisition leaf until a download path ships' and ERR-01 exactly-five rule. binaries.md specs the download and digest path (owner default 7) but names no exception type; digest mismatch has no home in the five leaves or the launch Reasons.
findings.evidence: binaries.md BIN rows vs errors.md ERR-01 leaf list.
findings.fix: In binaries.md name the exception (a launch Reason or a sixth leaf) for digest mismatch and update ERR-01 count when the download path rows land.

findings.problem: errors.md keeps x-ocx-enum (conformance snippet), the message template 'ocx <command> failed ...' (CS-ERR-08), and DestinationFiles="$(OutDir)ocx" (14a) without labelling them example names. json.md labels x-ocx-enum an example marker; the names intro list omits them.
findings.evidence: grep ocx errors.md.
findings.fix: Label each as an example (e.g. 'example name') or generalise to <tool>; add them to the names intro list.

findings.problem: CS-API-12 says the msbuild cell 'prints four values'. With multiple -getProperty, msbuild prints one JSON object.
findings.evidence: dotnet msbuild -getProperty:A,B,C,D output is {"Properties":{...}}.
findings.fix: Say 'prints one JSON object with four properties'.

findings.problem: CS-API-03 replaced the consolidation '// extension point: <reason>' comment with [SuppressMessage("Design","MA0053",Justification="extension point: ...")]. Functionally right (a comment cannot suppress an error-level MA0053) but no authoring note covers the change.
findings.evidence: consolidation text vs api-design.md CS-API-03.
findings.fix: Add a line to the Integration log recording the change and reason.

findings.problem: CS-ERR-11 (CONSIDER) has no 'What Agents Get Wrong' entry, one exemplar, fails selection criterion 1. CS-ERR-17 and CS-API-16 also absent from the failure list. CS-API-06 overlaps CS-PROC-08 P2.
findings.evidence: Failure-list vs row IDs; processes.md P2 block.
findings.fix: Drop or fold ERR-11 into ERR-08; add failure-list entries or cut ERR-17/API-16; make API-06 a pointer to PROC-08 P2.

findings.problem: Undated measurements: 'Stripe: 6,060 open types, 1 sealed', '0 of 8 SDK exemplar cores depend on DI', '.NET 11 RC1 accepts them', and the 12+ entries claim.
findings.evidence: grep of those phrases in both files; N-8/N-11 require dated measurements.
findings.fix: Append 'as of 2026-10' (or the research date) to each count and the RC claim.

reviews.trigger_eval: Plants trip the A01-A20 and ERR Check cells in their simple one-line forms; own-line attributes (F9), partial records (F8) and filter-form swallows (F12) evade them. On heldout trees the API-04, API-06, API-08 and ERR-09 scans fire mostly on non-targets (internal types, CancellationToken, extension-point abstract classes), so agents would learn to ignore their output. Rule load globs not re-measured.

reviews.report:
REVIEW RECORD: skills/dotnet-diagnose (SKILL.md 230 lines, references/catalogue.md 159 lines, 66 rows DN-DIAG-01..66, IDs contiguous and unique). Date 2026-10-11, SDK 10.0.401 / 8.0.425 / 11.0 RC1 through run.sh. Fixtures: fixtures/review-diagnose (cases/*, cells.py, s*.sh, p*.sh, tree/ = copy of microsoft__kiota-dotnet). Held-out clone never modified.
